questions.why: Mark Grayson is the half-human, half-Viltrumite teenager who becomes Invincible.

questions.q: Which hero alias does Mark's father use?
questions.why: Mark's father, Nolan, is the Viltrumite hero Omni-Man.

questions.q: Which superheroine is Mark's wife in the comics?
questions.why: The character's infobox lists Atom Eve as Mark's wife.

questions.q: Who co-created Invincible with writer Robert Kirkman?
questions.why: Kirkman and Walker created Invincible, and Ryan Ottley later became the main artist.

questions.q: Who voices Mark in Amazon's Invincible animated series?
questions.why: Yeun voices Mark, while J.K. Simmons voices Omni-Man.

questions.q: Which Grand Regent of the Viltrum Empire is Mark's main foe?
questions.why: Thragg is Mark's main Viltrumite opponent, and Mark eventually rules the empire.

questions.q: In what year did Amazon's animated Invincible premiere?
In which other Image series did Invincible first appear in a 2002 preview?
questions.why: A preview ran in Savage Dragon #102 in August 2002, before Invincible #1.

questions.q: Mark teams up with which Marvel hero in Marvel Team-Up #14?
questions.why: The crossover pits them against Doctor Octopus.

questions.q: What is the name of Mark's half-brother, who takes on a junior version of his father's hero name?
questions.why: Oliver Grayson is Mark's half-brother, who grows up as Kid Omni-Man.
